rule: D11 audit of D32 event matches (D20)
checks: event meets a D32 criterion (UCDP-first death tally, GDP effect, or IMF/World Bank review); match to the WEF risk; that risk's rank in the January edition of the event year; the verdict under D32.
sample: 2007|US subprime mortgage crisis and global financial turmoil (from August 2007)
2008|Oil and food price spike to mid-2008, then collapse
2009|Great Recession: global output contraction and collapse in world trade
2009|Sri Lankan civil war, final offensive against the LTTE
2011|Tohoku earthquake and tsunami and Fukushima nuclear accident (Japan)
2013|Fed taper tantrum and emerging market capital outflows
2014|Islamic State offensive and war in Iraq
2015|China slowdown, stock market crash and renminbi devaluation
2019|US-China trade war and global manufacturing and trade slowdown
2021|Post-pandemic supply-chain disruptions, energy price surge and inflation spike
2022|Energy and food price shock (European gas crisis, grain disruption)
2022|Global inflation surge and synchronized monetary tightening
2023|Sudan civil war (SAF vs RSF, from April 2023)
2025|Middle East wars (Gaza, Israel-Iran war of June 2025, Lebanon)
2025|Sudan civil war and famine (incl. fall of El Fasher)
2025|US tariff escalation and global trade tensions
method: Population: the 85 events both blind matchers agreed on (summary-d32.json, status agreed). Draw: scripts/measure-audit-sample.mjs (the drawSample of scripts/audit-sample.mjs without the miss weight), seed d11:wef-global-risks:d32, 50 of 85, stratified by verdict (16 ranked_high, 32 ranked_low, 2 absent). Per event: the D32 criterion and tally (conflict deaths re-read from the UCDP GED series on Our World in Data; other tallies from the cited study or review), the match to the WEF risk, and that risk's rank in the edition PDF (Wayback copies). In summary-d32.json a correct replaces the verdict and a contest removes it, as scripts/final-d20.mjs does for D20 sources.
